sections.heading: Why 90% of Objections Happen in Minute 6 (Not Minute 28)
sections.body: Most closers treat objections like a debate at the end of the call. S-tier closers prevent them early by quantifying the real cost of staying stuck before ever mentioning a solution or price.
bullets: Target talk-to-listen ratio: You 30%, Prospect 70%.
Never pitch features before the buyer explicitly names their #1 bottleneck.
Calm curiosity beats pressure tactics on every deal above $2,500.

sections.heading: The 3-Layer Pain Diagnosis Framework
sections.body: Move every discovery call cleanly through three escalating layers so the buyer argues for solving the problem themselves:
bullets: Layer 1 (Symptom): "What made you book this call today instead of 3 months from now?"
Layer 2 (Quantified Cost): "If this stays exactly the same for the next 6 months, what does that cost in lost revenue or time?"
Layer 3 (Urgency Lock): "On a scale of 1-10, how urgent is fixing this in the next 30 days?"

sections.heading: Word-for-Word Rebuttals for the Top 3 High-Ticket Objections
sections.body: Keep these three calm, non-defensive responses beside your monitor during every Zoom call:

blocks:
You are quietly losing 60% of warm prospects in minute 4 of your sales call.

Pitching features before diagnosing urgency destroys authority.

Here is the exact 3-Layer Pain Ladder S-tier closers run instead (bookmark this thread) 🧵👇

1/ Layer 1 — Surface Symptom:

Never ask "Tell me about your business."

Ask: "What made you book this call today instead of waiting another 3 months?"

Now the buyer tells you what actually hurts right now.

2/ Layer 2 — Quantified Cost of Inaction:

Follow with: "If this stays exactly the same for 6 months, what does it cost you in revenue or hours?"

Now your price is measured against the real cost of doing nothing.

3/ Layer 3 — Urgency Lock:

Finish discovery with: "On a 1–10 scale, how urgent is fixing this in the next 30 days?"

Pitch only the gap they just named. Watch price objections drop by half.
